description: Fork of exp174 (val_bpb=1.6478). Two changes: (1) Drop V2D/D2V at LUTBlock output, keep LayerNorm. (2) Replace MLP unembedder with LUT-based: LN(384) → TinyMultiHeadLut(384→128, n_heads=1, tph=4096, nap=8, n_alt=1, hard-lookup) with built-in sparse_scatter to vocab=32768 + trainable per-vocab bias. Unembedder LUT params: 4096*256*128 = 134.2M + 32k bias. Total ~514M.
